task.title: Record the owner's criterion 3 decision (option B) and its implementation at 289b9b71 on L4b and L1
task.objective: The owner adopted option B for L4b criterion 3 on 2026-09-23, keeping the 80 % threshold: criterion 3 now counts an issue when the explanation a person sees holds a corrective action (the product's beside the answer, or the model's own; a screen hit or misattribution never counts), and the model's own rate is reported beside it and never credited. At 289b9b71 verify:ai-authoring-review reads criterion 3 MET at 17/17 and 17/17, the model's own text 9/17 and 7/17 with every one repeating the product's action (0/34 model-authored), criteria 1 and 4 PENDING, TARGET PENDING. The one verdict in the local review store is a template placeholder (reviewer YOUR_LABEL) and is not a person's assessment. Append a note to awkit-djnl.6 and to awkit-djnl.1 giving the decision, the commit, the result and what stays open (a person's review of 16 answers replacing the placeholder, the owner's confirmation of the 11 proposed verdicts, L1's go/no-go). Refresh the JSONL export. Nothing closes: both stay in_progress. No edge is added or removed. The lease writes .beads/** only, so the owner's untracked scripts/offline-benchmark/ and the already-edited state documents are outside it and untouched.

acceptance.description: awkit-djnl.6 and awkit-djnl.1 stay in_progress, each with a note naming the owner's option B decision, 289b9b71 and its result, no edge changes, the JSONL export is refreshed from the database, and the dashboard reports that its sources agree.

evidence.notes: 177/177 with the Overview banner on 'Sources agree' on round 1, after the two `bd update --append-notes`, `bd export -o .beads/issues.jsonl` and the already-edited state documents: 320 issues, 26 outstanding / 294 closed, 180 edges, and both narratives restating 65 PASS / 2 NOT RUN / 0 BLOCKED. Round 2 ran once after the lease release, because active-lease.json is a registered source, and was again 177/177 'Sources agree' with the same counts.

history.released_reason: L4b criterion 3 option B noted on awkit-djnl.6 and awkit-djnl.1, nothing closed, no edge changed, export refreshed
